title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: SAP Technical Lead
description:

Smart Energy Water (SEW) is the leading provider of cloud-based digital platforms that empower global energy, water, and gas providers. Our innovative AI-, ML-, and IoT-powered solutions deliver world-class Customer Experience (CX) and Workforce Experience (WX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Senior Delphi Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Developer with 5+ years of Delphi software development experience to join the software engineering team for our U.S. client. This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.


The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.


Responsibilities

  • Write well-designed, testable, documented code from the provided project requirements
  • Coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contribute to team meetings; and troubleshoot development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Support and develop other developers, providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Implement software changes with the awareness and sensitivity of impact on the system as a whole
  • Learn and adhere to the adopted coding standards used by the software ERP Development Team
  • Leverage Delphi experience and learn all other client development tools
  • Monitor assigned software development change requests and implement changes for requests based on priority
  • Review requirements for system changes and enhancements, analyze those requests, and translate them into necessary programming changes
  • Perform necessary designing, coding, debugging, testing, and documentation (using the Delphi IDE and any other necessary tools)


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of Delphi and SQL Server experience (FireDAC experience is a plus)
  • Experience with at least one object-oriented programming language (in addition to Delphi/Object Pascal) is a plus, e.g., Java, C#, C++, etc.
  • Experience with defining service architectures and solutions from business requirements, producing estimates, and managing delivery against those timelines
  • Supports and develops other developers by providing advice, cross-training, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage in technical discussions with peers and become a trusted technical advisor. Work with others to ensure code standards and best practices are followed
  • Experience writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications and services
  • Ability to coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contributing to team meetings; troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Implementing unit tests (DUnitX experience is a plus)


Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry and any related applications
  • Experience leading a small to medium-sized team, with assistance from outside parties
  • Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds
  • User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
  • Knack for benchmarking and optimization
  • Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system
  • Understanding the fundamental design principles behind a scalable application
  • Strong proficiency working in a containerized deployment environment
  • Experience writing well-formed RESTful APIs
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning and management tools such as GitHub
  • Working with AI tools within the development workflow


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Position Overview

Gemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters.   • Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
  • Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion


Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
  • Familiarity with eDiscovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
  • Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
  • Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus

Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora com visão de qualidade e espírito colaborativo, que além de codar, também se preocupe em testar, automatizar, validar e garantir a robustez das entregas. Este papel tem responsabilidade dupla: desenvolver e garantir a excelência técnica nas liberações, atuando de forma híbrida entre Dev e QA.

  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades de software com foco em qualidade, desempenho, manutenibilidade e experiência do usuário;

  • Investigar e corrigir erros, propondo melhorias com foco em performance, estabilidade e prevenção de falhas;

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada como Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno(a), atuando em sistemas de média ou alta complexidade;

  • Desejável vivência com frameworks como Spring, JPA e aplicação de design patterns;
  • Interesse ou experiência prática em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD);

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Position Overview

Gemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials
  • Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems
  • Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation
  • Coordinate with internal teams including eDiscovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks
  • Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals
  • Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation
  • Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution
  • Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretion


Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
  • Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
  • Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion


Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
  • Familiarity with eDiscovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
  • Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
  • Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus


About Gemean

Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like PythAI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients’ needs.

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack PL
description:
Como Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack Pleno na Sankhya, você atuará na tribo ERP Logística, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução e sustentação de sistemas críticos utilizados por grandes clientes. Essa frente é estratégica para a companhia, com forte exposição a demandas regulatórias, operacionais e ao relacionamento com áreas como Produto, Qualidade e PMO.


Você fará parte de um time que atua em manutenção de sistemas legados, propondo melhorias, identificando falhas e colaborando com a categorização e resolução de ordens de serviço (OS), com foco em performance, estabilidade e ganho de conhecimento funcional. Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora com visão de qualidade e espírito colaborativo, que além de codar, também se preocupe em testar, automatizar, validar e garantir a robustez das entregas. Este papel tem responsabilidade dupla: desenvolver e garantir a excelência técnica nas liberações, atuando de forma híbrida entre Dev e QA.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades de software com foco em qualidade, desempenho, manutenibilidade e experiência do usuário;
  • Participar da análise e interpretação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, colaborando com times de Produto, Qualidade e QA desde as fases iniciais;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, organizado e aderente aos padrões técnicos da Sankhya;
  • Realizar manutenção corretiva, evolutiva e adaptativa em sistemas e rotinas existentes;
  • Investigar e corrigir erros, propondo melhorias com foco em performance, estabilidade e prevenção de falhas;
  • Colaborar com a automação de testes e validação técnica das entregas, contribuindo para a robustez das versões liberadas;
  • Apoiar o time na definição de critérios de aceite, estratégias de teste e validação de cenários críticos;
  • Participar da definição de estimativas de esforço e planos de entrega, com visão integrada entre desenvolvimento e qualidade;
  • Atuar ativamente nos ritos ágeis do time (como dailies, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas), promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua;
  • Registrar e manter documentação técnica clara das funcionalidades desenvolvidas ou modificadas;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento técnico, boas práticas e aprendizados com o time, fortalecendo a cultura de excelência e colaboração.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada como Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno(a), atuando em sistemas de média ou alta complexidade;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Java (com foco em orientação a objetos);
  • Conhecimentos nas principais API Java (java.util, java.util.stream, java.time, java.util.concurrent).
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em frameworks de font-end como AngularJS ou React, além de HTML, CSS e JavaScript;
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacional como por exemplo: SQL Server e Oracle (consultas, tuning, modelagem e estrutura relacional);
  • Escrita de consultas avançadas (JOINs, índices) e análise de planos de execução
  • Experiência com versionamento de código utilizando GIT;
  • Desejável vivência com frameworks como Spring, JPA e aplicação de design patterns;
  • Interesse ou experiência prática em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD);
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários e ferramentas para sua implementação como por exemplo (JUnit e Mockito).
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e suas ferramentas (Robot Framework, CyPress, Postman).

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Position Overview

Gemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials
  • Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems
  • Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation
  • Coordinate with internal teams including eDiscovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks
  • Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals
  • Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation
  • Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution
  • Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretion


Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
  • Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
  • Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion


Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
  • Familiarity with eDiscovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
  • Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
  • Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus


About Gemean

Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like PythAI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients’ needs.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Detalhes da oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor Fullstack altamente qualificado(a), com forte expertise em testes automatizados, desenvolvimento backend utilizando tecnologias modernas .NET e experiência prática com serviços em nuvem Azure.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack PL
description:
Como Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack Pleno na Sankhya, você atuará na tribo ERP Logística, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução e sustentação de sistemas críticos utilizados por grandes clientes. Essa frente é estratégica para a companhia, com forte exposição a demandas regulatórias, operacionais e ao relacionamento com áreas como Produto, Qualidade e PMO.


Você fará parte de um time que atua em manutenção de sistemas legados, propondo melhorias, identificando falhas e colaborando com a categorização e resolução de ordens de serviço (OS), com foco em performance, estabilidade e ganho de conhecimento funcional. Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora com visão de qualidade e espírito colaborativo, que além de codar, também se preocupe em testar, automatizar, validar e garantir a robustez das entregas. Este papel tem responsabilidade dupla: desenvolver e garantir a excelência técnica nas liberações, atuando de forma híbrida entre Dev e QA.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades de software com foco em qualidade, desempenho, manutenibilidade e experiência do usuário;
  • Participar da análise e interpretação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, colaborando com times de Produto, Qualidade e QA desde as fases iniciais;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, organizado e aderente aos padrões técnicos da Sankhya;
  • Realizar manutenção corretiva, evolutiva e adaptativa em sistemas e rotinas existentes;
  • Investigar e corrigir erros, propondo melhorias com foco em performance, estabilidade e prevenção de falhas;
  • Colaborar com a automação de testes e validação técnica das entregas, contribuindo para a robustez das versões liberadas;
  • Apoiar o time na definição de critérios de aceite, estratégias de teste e validação de cenários críticos;
  • Participar da definição de estimativas de esforço e planos de entrega, com visão integrada entre desenvolvimento e qualidade;
  • Atuar ativamente nos ritos ágeis do time (como dailies, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas), promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua;
  • Registrar e manter documentação técnica clara das funcionalidades desenvolvidas ou modificadas;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento técnico, boas práticas e aprendizados com o time, fortalecendo a cultura de excelência e colaboração.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada como Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno(a), atuando em sistemas de média ou alta complexidade;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Java (com foco em orientação a objetos);
  • Conhecimentos nas principais API Java (java.util, java.util.stream, java.time, java.util.concurrent).
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em frameworks de font-end como AngularJS ou React, além de HTML, CSS e JavaScript;
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacional como por exemplo: SQL Server e Oracle (consultas, tuning, modelagem e estrutura relacional);
  • Escrita de consultas avançadas (JOINs, índices) e análise de planos de execução

title: Senior Software Engineer (C#/.NET/SQL)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of software development experience to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. This engineer will contribute to the development of OrderAI, an AI-powered system that allows restaurants to take customer orders through voice interactions.

This role involves working on customer-focused products backed by LLM technologies, including real-time voice interfaces. The engineer will be able to contribute at any point in the full development cycle from the identification of system requirements and enhancements, coding the system to address these requirements, testing the system for quality control, releasing system changes, and documentation of system changes. The ideal candidate is expected to contribute to a positive engineering culture and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 locations use their technology today processing $5 Billion in daily sales.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design, develop, and support existing systems as well as create new functionality for the OrderAI platform, with a focus on LLM-powered features, including building AI features, integrating LLM APIs, and working with prompts and voice systems
  • Write high-quality code following best practices and standards for coding, compliance, security, and performance using C#/.NET
  • Contribute to software development with an emphasis on backend design, quality, and implementation
  • Utilize the latest advances in AI and LLM technologies to improve the effectiveness of delivering business value within the AI ordering platform
  • Support and share knowledge with fellow engineers through code reviews and collaboration
  • Help troubleshoot issues and identify bug fixes across systems that support AI voice ordering and backend integrations


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience
  • Knowledge of Microsoft technologies including C# and Azure
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as SQL Server and PostgreSQL
  • Experience with queues, caching, CDNs, and other technologies used for building scalable applications
  • Demonstrated success delivering SaaS, e-commerce, or consumer-facing applications/APIs
  • Experience with distributed systems, cloud environments (Azure preferred), and modern architectures
  • Demonstrated ability to work individually as well as part of a team
  • Interest in working with LLM technologies and AI-driven products


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Exposure to LLM-powered systems or AI-driven applications
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI services into backend systems
  • Interest in building products that leverage voice-based or conversational interfaces
  • Experience supporting real-time or event-driven systems


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

title: Banco de Talentos GFT -  Inteligência Artificial (IA) & Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Banco de Talentos | Inteligência Artificial (IA) & Machine Learning Engineer


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de Inteligência Artificial (IA), com ênfase em IA Generativa e Engenharia de Machine Learning, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos inovadores, com alto impacto no negócio e uso de tecnologias de ponta.


Se você gosta de unir modelagem de IA com engenharia de software, criando soluções escaláveis e produtivas, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui


  • Desenvolver, treinar e otimizar modelos de Machine Learning e/ou Deep Learning;
  • Trabalhar com soluções de IA Generativa (LLMs, copilots, NLP, etc.);
  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de dados e ML (end-to-end);
  • Construir e disponibilizar modelos em produção (APIs, microsserviços);
  • Atuar com engenharia de ML, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e confiabilidade;
  • Trabalhar com integração de modelos em aplicações reais;
  • Monitorar, versionar e evoluir modelos em produção (MLOps);
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (dados, engenharia, produto);
  • Contribuir com boas práticas de arquitetura, qualidade e inovação em IA.


O que buscamos


  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python, Java e/ou .NET;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks e bibliotecas de IA/ML (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, etc.);
  • Experiência com IA Generativa (LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com construção de APIs e microsserviços para exposição de modelos;
  • Experiência com manipulação e análise de dados (Pandas, NumPy, SQL);
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP);
  • Familiaridade com práticas de MLOps (deploy, monitoramento, versionamento de modelos);
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Certificações em IA, dados ou cloud serão consideradas um diferencial.


Perfil que valorizamos


  • Forte capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico;
  • Perfil híbrido entre dados e engenharia de software;
  • Proatividade e autonomia na resolução de problemas;
  • Curiosidade e interesse por inovação e novas tecnologias;
  • Colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e orientados à experimentação;
  • Foco em geração de valor a partir de soluções inteligentes.


Se identificou? Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js/Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.


The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!


Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities


  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience


  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake


Desired Experience


  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information


  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values


  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. Theres no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient


We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Location: Remote (Brazil-based only)

Salary: $3,500-4,500 per month

Job Type: Contract

We are seeking a skilled .NET Developer to join our growing development team. This fully remote role is open to candidates based in Brazil and offers the opportunity to work on modern application development projects in a supportive and agile environment.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions using .NET / .NET Core , SQL , and AWS technologies. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a strong understanding of application development lifecycle is essential.

description:
Como Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack Pleno na Sankhya, você atuará na tribo ERP Logística, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução e sustentação de sistemas críticos utilizados por grandes clientes. Essa frente é estratégica para a companhia, com forte exposição a demandas regulatórias, operacionais e ao relacionamento com áreas como Produto, Qualidade e PMO.


Você fará parte de um time que atua em manutenção de sistemas legados, propondo melhorias, identificando falhas e colaborando com a categorização e resolução de ordens de serviço (OS), com foco em performance, estabilidade e ganho de conhecimento funcional. Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora com visão de qualidade e espírito colaborativo, que além de codar, também se preocupe em testar, automatizar, validar e garantir a robustez das entregas. Este papel tem responsabilidade dupla: desenvolver e garantir a excelência técnica nas liberações, atuando de forma híbrida entre Dev e QA.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades de software com foco em qualidade, desempenho, manutenibilidade e experiência do usuário;
  • Participar da análise e interpretação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, colaborando com times de Produto, Qualidade e QA desde as fases iniciais;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, organizado e aderente aos padrões técnicos da Sankhya;
  • Realizar manutenção corretiva, evolutiva e adaptativa em sistemas e rotinas existentes;
  • Investigar e corrigir erros, propondo melhorias com foco em performance, estabilidade e prevenção de falhas;
  • Colaborar com a automação de testes e validação técnica das entregas, contribuindo para a robustez das versões liberadas;
  • Apoiar o time na definição de critérios de aceite, estratégias de teste e validação de cenários críticos;
  • Participar da definição de estimativas de esforço e planos de entrega, com visão integrada entre desenvolvimento e qualidade;
  • Atuar ativamente nos ritos ágeis do time (como dailies, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas), promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua;
  • Registrar e manter documentação técnica clara das funcionalidades desenvolvidas ou modificadas;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento técnico, boas práticas e aprendizados com o time, fortalecendo a cultura de excelência e colaboração.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada como Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno(a), atuando em sistemas de média ou alta complexidade;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Java (com foco em orientação a objetos);
  • Conhecimentos nas principais API Java (java.util, java.util.stream, java.time, java.util.concurrent).
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em frameworks de font-end como AngularJS ou React, além de HTML, CSS e JavaScript;
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacional como por exemplo: SQL Server e Oracle (consultas, tuning, modelagem e estrutura relacional);
  • Escrita de consultas avançadas (JOINs, índices) e análise de planos de execução
  • Experiência com versionamento de código utilizando GIT;
  • Desejável vivência com frameworks como Spring, JPA e aplicação de design patterns;
  • Interesse ou experiência prática em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD);
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários e ferramentas para sua implementação como por exemplo (JUnit e Mockito).
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e suas ferramentas (Robot Framework, CyPress, Postman).
  • Conhecimento em escrita de testes usando ferramentas como gherkin.
  • Mentalidade de qualidade: valorizamos profissionais que consideram a excelência técnica desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega, com atenção a performance, cobertura de testes e prevenção de bugs.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company. They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering our flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure our software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Webix UI platform
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. Certifications beneficial: AZ-204, AZ-900
  • Experience with DevOps Pipelines, YAML.
  • Experience using OpenAI or other AI API Platforms
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor or similar).
  • Knowledge of monitoring/logging tools (App Insights, CloudWatch, DataDog).
  • Experience with performance profiling



This is a CLT Role at R$18,000/month

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
Sobre a empresa:

  • Empresa multinacional do setor Financeiro até Logística para marcas de consumo nos EUA e na UE.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Supervisionar a alocação de estoque para pedidos B2B de múltiplas marcas que operam nos EUA e na Europa
  • Projetar a disponibilidade de estoque e fornecer visibilidade dos prazos futuros de entrega com base nos recebimentos de estoque
  • Recomendar ajustes ou extensões nos prazos das janelas de entrega para pedidos ou grupos de produtos, conforme a disponibilidade de estoque
  • Coordenar com o financeiro para garantir que os pedidos sejam liberados para cobrança antes dos embarques
  • Liberar pedidos para os armazéns com base nas janelas de entrega e garantir que as priorizações estejam alinhadas às necessidades do negócio
  • Colaborar com o especialista de logística outbound para acompanhar as prioridades diárias e o progresso junto aos 3PLs
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato para as equipes de vendas dos clientes, fornecendo atualizações de status, ajustes e feedback sobre os pedidos


O que você precisa ter:

  • Fluente em inglês, tanto falado quanto escrito
  • Pessoa proativa, orientada a soluções e focada em escalabilidade
  • Experiência em alocação de pedidos, customer success ou gestão da cadeia de suprimentos
  • Tem vontade de aprender a dinâmica de gerenciar múltiplos clientes e varejistas em diferentes países
  • Possui fortes habilidades organizacionais, de comunicação e de resolução de problemas, com grande atenção aos detalhes
  • Tem familiaridade com operações de 3PL, sistemas de gestão de pedidos ou ferramentas de planejamento de inventário (diferencial)
  • Sabe gerenciar prioridades e se adaptar a ambientes em constante mudança


Observações:

  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Tipo de contrato: PJ

title: Analista de Produto Júnior (Vibecoder)
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

Procuramos um estudante ou recém-formado em Economia (ou áreas correlatas) que queira acelerar sua entrada no mercado de tecnologia através da Inteligência Artificial Operacional.

Você não será um programador focado em sintaxe tradicional, mas um Vibecoder: um profissional que utiliza o poder do Claude Code e agentes de IA para construir, gerenciar e escalar serviços de dados reais na nuvem.

O que você vai fazer (The Vibe)

● Vibe Coding: Operar o Claude Code para conectar repositórios no GitHub, baixar skills e automatizar processos de dados com velocidade de IA.

● Gestão de Cloud: Supervisionar e configurar a infraestrutura no Google Cloud (Functions, Run, BigQuery) com o apoio das nossas ferramentas.

● Curadoria de UX: Sabemos que você não é designer e não esperamos que saiba usar ferramentas de desenho. Nós vamos te treinar para desenvolver um senso crítico apurado sobre hierarquia de informação. Seu papel será supervisionar e guiar as IAs para que o produto final seja útil, claro e eficiente para o usuário.

Perfil do Candidato

● Background Analítico (Economia/Exatas): Capacidade de entender a lógica de custos, incentivos e eficiência de processos.

● Mindset Pragmático: Foco em resolver o problema do cliente da forma mais inteligente e automatizada possível.

● Curiosidade Tecnológica: Vontade de dominar o ecossistema Google Cloud e ferramentas de \"coding-by-chat\".

● Vontade de Aprender: Disposição para passar pelo nosso treinamento proprietário de UX e Cloud.

O que oferecemos

● Treinamento de Elite: Acesso ao nosso Gem de IA, um tutor exclusivo que te guiará passo a passo em Cloud, Vibe Coding e Design Crítico.

● Cultura AI-First: Ambiente onde a produtividade via IA é a regra, não a exceção.

● Autonomia Real: Espaço para gerenciar produtos de dados e influenciar decisões de arquitetura e interface.



Benefícios:

Assistência Médica e odontológica · Seguro de Vida · Vale Alimentação/Refeição · Gympass ️ · 3 Days Off por ano

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Administrator

Location: Remote (LATAM)

Duration: 6months

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Salesforce Administrator to manage, configure, and optimize our Salesforce platform. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions while ensuring data integrity, automation efficiency, and user adoption.


Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain the Salesforce platform including user setup, profiles, roles, and permissions
  • Design and implement custom objects, fields, validation rules, workflows, and flows
  • Build and manage reports and dashboards for business insights
  • Automate business processes using Flow, Process Builder (legacy), and approval processes
  • Perform data management including imports, deduplication, and data quality monitoring
  • Support Sales, Service, and other cloud users with issue resolution and enhancements
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and translate business requirements
  • Ensure system security, compliance, and best practices
  • Manage releases, change sets, and deployments
  • Provide user training and drive Salesforce adoption


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator
  • Strong expertise in:
  • Salesforce configuration (Objects, Fields, Layouts)
  • Flow Builder (must-have)
  • Reports & Dashboards
  • Data Loader / Data Import Wizard
  • Understanding of Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud
  • Knowledge of security model (Profiles, Roles, Sharing Rules)
  • Experience with data quality and governance
  • Familiarity with integration concepts (REST/SOAP APIs – basic level)
  • Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills


Primary Skills

1.Salesforce Platform hands-on experience

2.Salesforce admin expertise (Security Model, Data Model, End to End configuration, Flows etc)

3. Salesforce Admin Cert

4. Reports & Dashboards – Handson


Secondary Skills

1. Sales Cloud, Service Cloud

2. Business analysis

3. Stakeholder Management

title: [Dados] Engenharia de Dados Senior
description:
Descrição da vaga

Acreditamos que o SUCESSO do cliente é o nosso SUCESSO!

E para isso, estamos à procura de pessoas inquietas, fanáticas por resultados e amantes de tecnologia, para apoiar na implementação de Inteligência artificial nas soluções mobile e em nuvem para a área de Logística.

Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, trabalho em equipe e gosta de fazer acontecer esta vaga será sua!

Venha trabalhar em um ambiente que valoriza gente boa que é boa gente.

Venha ser um TOTVS!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estruturar e preparar pipelines de dados para alimentar soluções de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Atuar no treinamento, avaliação e evolução de modelos de Machine Learning integrados aos produtos de Logística;
  • Garantir a rastreabilidade e governança dos dados, seguindo os padrões corporativos de qualidade;
  • Implementar melhorias contínuas em modelos já em produção para garantir a aderência ao negócio.

  • Formação superior completa ou cursando em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Prática em estruturação de dados, preparação de datasets e construção de pipelines;

  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de Data Warehouse e Data Lake;
  • Noções de MLOps, incluindo versionamento de modelos e automação.


Diferenciais (O que te destaca)

  • Proficiência em Python e SQL (essenciais para a manipulação de dados na nossa stack);

  • Conhecimento em IA Generativa e implementação de LLMs;
  • Prática com streaming de dados e inferência em tempo real;
  • Experiência prévia em sistemas logísticos ou operacionais.

title: Analista de Produto Júnior (Vibecoder)
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

Procuramos um estudante ou recém-formado em Economia (ou áreas correlatas) que queira acelerar sua entrada no mercado de tecnologia através da Inteligência Artificial Operacional.

Você não será um programador focado em sintaxe tradicional, mas um Vibecoder: um profissional que utiliza o poder do Claude Code e agentes de IA para construir, gerenciar e escalar serviços de dados reais na nuvem.

O que você vai fazer (The Vibe)

● Vibe Coding: Operar o Claude Code para conectar repositórios no GitHub, baixar skills e automatizar processos de dados com velocidade de IA.

● Gestão de Cloud: Supervisionar e configurar a infraestrutura no Google Cloud (Functions, Run, BigQuery) com o apoio das nossas ferramentas.

● Curadoria de UX: Sabemos que você não é designer e não esperamos que saiba usar ferramentas de desenho. Nós vamos te treinar para desenvolver um senso crítico apurado sobre hierarquia de informação. Seu papel será supervisionar e guiar as IAs para que o produto final seja útil, claro e eficiente para o usuário.

Perfil do Candidato

● Background Analítico (Economia/Exatas): Capacidade de entender a lógica de custos, incentivos e eficiência de processos.

● Mindset Pragmático: Foco em resolver o problema do cliente da forma mais inteligente e automatizada possível.

● Curiosidade Tecnológica: Vontade de dominar o ecossistema Google Cloud e ferramentas de \"coding-by-chat\".

● Vontade de Aprender: Disposição para passar pelo nosso treinamento proprietário de UX e Cloud.

O que oferecemos

● Treinamento de Elite: Acesso ao nosso Gem de IA, um tutor exclusivo que te guiará passo a passo em Cloud, Vibe Coding e Design Crítico.

● Cultura AI-First: Ambiente onde a produtividade via IA é a regra, não a exceção.

● Autonomia Real: Espaço para gerenciar produtos de dados e influenciar decisões de arquitetura e interface.



Benefícios:

Assistência Médica e odontológica · Seguro de Vida · Vale Alimentação/Refeição · Gympass ️ · 3 Days Off por ano

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
Sobre a empresa:

  • Empresa multinacional do setor Financeiro até Logística para marcas de consumo nos EUA e na UE.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Supervisionar a alocação de estoque para pedidos B2B de múltiplas marcas que operam nos EUA e na Europa
  • Projetar a disponibilidade de estoque e fornecer visibilidade dos prazos futuros de entrega com base nos recebimentos de estoque
  • Recomendar ajustes ou extensões nos prazos das janelas de entrega para pedidos ou grupos de produtos, conforme a disponibilidade de estoque
  • Coordenar com o financeiro para garantir que os pedidos sejam liberados para cobrança antes dos embarques
  • Liberar pedidos para os armazéns com base nas janelas de entrega e garantir que as priorizações estejam alinhadas às necessidades do negócio
  • Colaborar com o especialista de logística outbound para acompanhar as prioridades diárias e o progresso junto aos 3PLs
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato para as equipes de vendas dos clientes, fornecendo atualizações de status, ajustes e feedback sobre os pedidos


O que você precisa ter:

  • Fluente em inglês, tanto falado quanto escrito
  • Pessoa proativa, orientada a soluções e focada em escalabilidade
  • Experiência em alocação de pedidos, customer success ou gestão da cadeia de suprimentos
  • Tem vontade de aprender a dinâmica de gerenciar múltiplos clientes e varejistas em diferentes países
  • Possui fortes habilidades organizacionais, de comunicação e de resolução de problemas, com grande atenção aos detalhes
  • Tem familiaridade com operações de 3PL, sistemas de gestão de pedidos ou ferramentas de planejamento de inventário (diferencial)
  • Sabe gerenciar prioridades e se adaptar a ambientes em constante mudança


Observações:

  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Tipo de contrato: PJ

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company. They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering our flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure our software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Webix UI platform
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. Certifications beneficial: AZ-204, AZ-900
  • Experience with DevOps Pipelines, YAML.
  • Experience using OpenAI or other AI API Platforms
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor or similar).
  • Knowledge of monitoring/logging tools (App Insights, CloudWatch, DataDog).
  • Experience with performance profiling



This is a CLT Role at R$18,000/month

title: Senior Wordpress Developer (Subscription & Circulation Systems)
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Integrate WordPress with subscription, paywall, and circulation systems .
  • Build and maintain API integrations between WordPress and external platforms.
  • Ensure reliable synchronization of user data, subscriptions, billing, and content access .
  • Design backend services and middleware to support multi-system communication .
  • Work closely with product and data teams to support subscription and audience workflows.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize data flows across systems for performance and reliability.
  • Develop scalable solutions for high-traffic media platforms .


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of WordPress development experience with backend focus.
  • Strong experience with API integrations and distributed systems .
  • Experience with platforms such as Darwin CX and Naviga NCS Circ .
  • Experience with subscription/paywall systems and audience management platforms.
  • Proficiency in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and REST/webhooks.
  • Experience integrating WordPress with external SaaS platforms or enterprise systems .
  • Understanding of authentication, data synchronization, and system reliability.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Administrator

Location: Remote (LATAM)

Duration: 6months

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Salesforce Administrator to manage, configure, and optimize our Salesforce platform. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions while ensuring data integrity, automation efficiency, and user adoption.


Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain the Salesforce platform including user setup, profiles, roles, and permissions
  • Design and implement custom objects, fields, validation rules, workflows, and flows
  • Build and manage reports and dashboards for business insights
  • Automate business processes using Flow, Process Builder (legacy), and approval processes
  • Perform data management including imports, deduplication, and data quality monitoring
  • Support Sales, Service, and other cloud users with issue resolution and enhancements
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and translate business requirements
  • Ensure system security, compliance, and best practices
  • Manage releases, change sets, and deployments
  • Provide user training and drive Salesforce adoption


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator
  • Strong expertise in:
  • Salesforce configuration (Objects, Fields, Layouts)
  • Flow Builder (must-have)
  • Reports & Dashboards
  • Data Loader / Data Import Wizard
  • Understanding of Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud
  • Knowledge of security model (Profiles, Roles, Sharing Rules)
  • Experience with data quality and governance
  • Familiarity with integration concepts (REST/SOAP APIs – basic level)
  • Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills


Primary Skills

1.Salesforce Platform hands-on experience

2.Salesforce admin expertise (Security Model, Data Model, End to End configuration, Flows etc)

3. Salesforce Admin Cert

4. Reports & Dashboards – Handson


Secondary Skills

1. Sales Cloud, Service Cloud

2. Business analysis

3. Stakeholder Management

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English
